purpose: Independently verify and promote Markdown-to-PDF conversion using Pandoc+WeasyPrint.
goal: Convert a fresh Markdown fixture to PDF and independently prove its semantic text using verified pypdf extraction.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
cat > canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MARKDOWN_PDF_VERIFY.md <<'EOF'
# PROJECT BRAIN PDF CONVERSION

| Capability | State |
| --- | --- |
| ALPHA-VERIFY-7319 | VERIFIED |
| BETA-VERIFY-2846 | COMPLETE |
EOF
grep -q 'ALPHA-VERIFY-7319' canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MARKDOWN_PDF_VERIFY.md
echo MARKDOWN_FIXTURE_CREATED

set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('astra_runtime_pdf_verify',p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=m; s.loader.exec_module(m)
out=m._invoke_bound_capability({
 'capability_id':'document.convert.markdown_pdf.pandoc_weasyprint',
 'markdown_path':'canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MARKDOWN_PDF_VERIFY.md',
 'output_path':'canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MARKDOWN_PDF_VERIFY.pdf',
 'timeout_s':180
})
(root/'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-VERIFY-MARKDOWN-PDF-001__PRODUCER.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
assert out.get('output_verified') is True
print('MARKDOWN_PDF_PRODUCED')
PY

set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib,re,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('astra_runtime_pdf_readback',p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=m; s.loader.exec_module(m)
out=m._invoke_bound_capability({
 'capability_id':'pdf.extract.text.pypdf',
 'path':'canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MARKDOWN_PDF_VERIFY.pdf',
 'max_pages':20
})
text=str(out.get('text') or '')
required=['PROJECT BRAIN PDF CONVERSION','ALPHA-VERIFY-7319','BETA-VERIFY-2846','VERIFIED','COMPLETE']
norm=lambda x: re.sub(r'[^A-Z0-9]+','',str(x).upper())
observed_norm=norm(text)
missing=[x for x in required if norm(x) not in observed_norm]
assert not missing,{'missing':missing,'text':text}
ev={'schema':'PROJECT_BRAIN_INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC_VERIFICATION_V1','verified':True,'verification_mode':'LAYOUT_INSENSITIVE_ALNUM','verifier_capability':'pdf.extract.text.pypdf','required_strings':required,'extracted_text':text,'normalized_text':observed_norm}
(root/'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-VERIFY-MARKDOWN-PDF-001__INDEPENDENT.json').write_text(json.dumps(ev,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('MARKDOWN_PDF_INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC_VERIFIED')
PY

set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
rp=root/'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json'
reg=json.loads(rp.read_text())
cap=reg['capabilities']['document.convert.markdown_pdf.pandoc_weasyprint']
assert cap['status']=='BOUND_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION'
ie=json.loads((root/'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-VERIFY-MARKDOWN-PDF-001__INDEPENDENT.json').read_text())
assert ie.get('verified') is True
cap['status']='VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY'
cap['verification']={
 'mission_id':'ASTRA-VERIFY-MARKDOWN-PDF-001',
 'independent_verified':True,
 'independent_verifier_capability':'pdf.extract.text.pypdf',
 'verification_evidence':'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-VERIFY-MARKDOWN-PDF-001__INDEPENDENT.json'
}
rp.write_text(json.dumps(reg,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('MARKDOWN_PDF_CAPABILITY_PROMOTED')
PY
